# Assets · Icons

19 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

These are the glyphs `LaColombe.Icons` and every `icon=` prop render — mount the component wherever the bundle runs; the files are for surfaces without it (a deck).

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for arrow-rtl.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The La Colombe icon set: 24px grid, 1.5px line, round caps and joins, no fill.

Every SVG is single-ink in earth brown `#4A3B2A` (`secondary-700`), because an `<img>` cannot inherit `currentColor`. To recolor, use the inline sprite in the Icons component or edit the `stroke` value. `chevron-rtl.svg` and `arrow-rtl.svg` are the mirrored versions for right-to-left pages; all other icons never mirror.
